coffee_leaf_rust.name: Coffee Leaf Rust
coffee_leaf_rust.description: Orange or yellow powdery spots on the underside of leaves. Spreads fast in wet, warm weather.
coffee_leaf_rust.immediateAction: Remove and burn heavily affected branches. Do not compost them.
coffee_leaf_rust.treatment: Apply copper-based fungicide (e.g. Copper Oxychloride) within 3 days. Repeat every 2 weeks during wet season.
coffee_leaf_rust.yieldImpact: Can reduce yield by 30–50% if untreated.

coffee_leaf_miner.name: Coffee Leaf Miner
coffee_leaf_miner.description: Small blister-like mines on leaf surface, caused by caterpillars tunneling inside the leaf.
coffee_leaf_miner.immediateAction: Pick off and destroy affected leaves. Check surrounding plants for spread.
coffee_leaf_miner.treatment: Apply neem-based insecticide or pyrethroid spray. Target early morning when insects are active.
coffee_leaf_miner.yieldImpact: Can cause 20–30% defoliation if outbreak is severe.

coffee_phoma.name: Phoma Leaf Spot
coffee_phoma.description: Dark brown spots with yellow halo on leaves, often after cold or rainy periods at high altitude.
coffee_phoma.immediateAction: Remove affected leaves. Improve air circulation by pruning dense canopy.
coffee_phoma.treatment: Apply copper-based or systemic fungicide. Avoid overhead irrigation.
coffee_phoma.yieldImpact: Reduces photosynthesis; severe cases cause early leaf drop.

coffee_brown_eye.name: Brown Eye Spot
coffee_brown_eye.description: Circular brown spots with a lighter center — looks like an eye. Common in young plants or nutrient-stressed trees.
coffee_brown_eye.immediateAction: Check soil nutrients — often linked to nitrogen or potassium deficiency.
coffee_brown_eye.treatment: Apply balanced fertilizer. Use copper spray if spots are spreading rapidly.
coffee_brown_eye.yieldImpact: Mainly cosmetic unless plant is already stressed. Address nutrition first.

healthy.name: Healthy Plant
healthy.description: No disease detected. This plant looks healthy.
healthy.immediateAction: Continue regular monitoring. Check again after rain.
healthy.treatment: Maintain regular fertilization schedule and canopy management.

unknown.name: Not Sure
unknown.description: The image isn't clear enough to identify the problem with confidence.
unknown.immediateAction: Take a closer, clearer photo in good light. If problem persists, contact your extension officer.
unknown.treatment: Do not apply treatment without a confident diagnosis.
